hooks.command: IN=$(cat); if printf %s "$IN" | grep -q score_test && ! grep -rqs '"frozen": true' runs; then echo 'gate: the test split is locked until FREEZE - no runs/**/state.json says "frozen": true' >&2; exit 2; fi; if printf %s "$IN" | grep -Eq 'apply([^a-z_]|$)' && [ -z "$(find runs -name '*.approved' 2>/dev/null)" ]; then echo 'gate: apply needs proposals/<id>.approved holding the user'"'"'s exact words - show the proposal and ask first' >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
